experiment_data.hypothesis: MLM domain-adapted model will maintain robustness under adversarial perturbation (0pp degradation), matching persuasion treatment and confirming domain adaptation (not classification supervision) drives perturbation robustness
experiment_data.notes: Hypothesis falsified: MLM model shows moderate perturbation degradation (full F1: 1.0→0.9737, delta=-0.0263), NOT matching treatment's 0pp drop. MLM robustness is intermediate: better than vanilla baseline (-0.1176) but clearly worse than persuasion treatment (0.0). At k=1, MLM drops -0.0922 vs treatment -0.0256. Domain adaptation alone provides partial but insufficient perturbation robustness — classification supervision on persuasion-augmented data is necessary for full robustness.
